user.title: Select a Hunter NODE-BT
user.description: Enter the controller PIN. The factory default PIN is 0000.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Enter the controller PIN. The factory default PIN is 0000.

abort.no_devices_found: No connectable Hunter NODE-BT controllers were found

init.title: Manual watering
init.description: Choose the run time used when a station valve is opened without an explicit duration.

error.invalid_run_time: Enter a whole number of seconds

start_watering.name: Start watering
start_watering.description: Run a station for a bounded controller-enforced duration.

set_program.name: Set stored program
set_program.description: Read, patch, and verify a controller-resident program. Omitted fields are preserved.

device_id.name: Controller
device_id.description: Select one loaded Hunter NODE-BT controller.

program.name: Program
program.description: Stored program A, B, or C.

name.name: Program name
name.description: A name of 1–14 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

station_runtimes.name: Station runtimes
station_runtimes.description: Map physical station numbers to integer seconds, 0–3600. Zero skips a station. Edit start times separately.

start_times.name: Start times
start_times.description: Replace all slots with sorted HH:MM times or null. Cannot be combined with runtime edits.

start_time_slots.name: Individual start slots
start_time_slots.description: Map positions 1–8 to HH:MM or null. Times are sorted and compacted after editing. Cannot be combined with start_times or runtime edits.

weekdays.name: Watering weekdays
weekdays.description: Select mon through sun; changes the program to weekday mode. An empty list selects no days.

require_daily_single_start.name: Validate daily duration synchronization
require_daily_single_start.description: Requires only runtime edits, one daily start, no overlapping programs for these stations, and seasonal scaling disabled.

clear_start_time.name: Clear program start time
clear_start_time.description: Disable the selected stored start slot. Set its time again to enable it.
